text_block_list.text: On our way back from a day out, Seiun Sky and I run into Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hoo boy. There she goes again, sighing away like she's getting paid for it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yeah, she's been acting a little out of it lately.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You go on ahead. I'll catch up!
Seiun Sky sprints off. I chase after her out of concern and soon find her standing in front of a grocer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, these carrots look good. ♪ The color, the shine… They're downright perfect.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's a darn waste you're not advertising these veggies. I think you could sell a truckload of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Vegetable Seller
text_block_list.text: Well, now! Someone's got a real eye for carrots! I might just give that a shot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …There we go. Now I just have to wait for Spe to walk this way.

text_block_list.name: Vegetable Seller
text_block_list.text: Hello there, young lady! Might I interest you in a perfect carrot?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vegetable Seller
text_block_list.text: Take a look at the color, the shine! And they're chock-full of nutrients! You know what, I'll even give you one on the house!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …No, I'm okay. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Are you kidding me?! She passed on a carrot?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I see… I'm gonna have to break out the big tackle for this one!
Next, Seiun Sky heads to a cafe, buys three slices of cake, and places them on a table.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Sei?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Spe! Nice timing! I ordered waaay too much cake.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wonder if you wouldn't mind doing me a solid and taking a slice?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh, I'm sorry, Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wha? Spe?! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: N-no way… This is cake we're talking about here…
Seiun Sky stands frozen in shock. Without thinking, I blurt something out.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wagh?! Trainer?! How long have you been there?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Never mind, I gotta—wait, there's no point chasing after her.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I mean, even if I chased her down, what would I do then? She just passed right over her favorite food.
choice_data_list: But you've gone to all this trouble because you can't turn a blind eye, right?
But you've gone to all this trouble because you can't turn a blind eye, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Ooh Trainer, you're one crafty devil.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sigh… All right, all right, I'll get chasing!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Wait up, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What? Sei?! Y-you followed me all the way here?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Uh, well… You know, I, uh, how do you say…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry I ran off back there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The truth is… I'm on a super strict diet right now!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, gotcha. A diet… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So that's why you've been all listless lately?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah! And I've been tempted so many times today. It's been a nightmare!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heh, ahahaha! So that's it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sheesh… Well I'll be.
choice_data_list: So the source of the temptation was none other than…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep. I guess Spe's gotta be Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Of course! Who else could I be?
I listen to their spirited conversation as the three of us make our way back to campus.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, keep quiet. Nobody likes a snitch.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What is it? Tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, my lips are sealed.
After that, Seiun Sky smiles the whole way home.
